mechanism: Windows ETW StartTraceW/EnableTraceEx2/ControlTraceW, custom standalone session; not WPR/PktMon
cleanup: Owned fixed descriptive session+freshGUID only; watchdog+finally termination, no global cancel/stop. Existing session means BLOCKED; no automatic cleanup of a different GUID.
privileges: Manual separately elevated PowerShell on exact same Windows host. No UAC/RunAs/group edits by helper. Existing Codex/test process remains ordinary token.
scope_limit: Kernel TCPIP ETW cannot safely use user-mode PID scope filter: documented PID filter suppresses kernel provider. No supported per-TCB native capture filter proven. Raw session contains only allowlisted structured metadata across host, protected local8MiB/45s; final export strictly fresh loopback tuple + observed process identity + TCB mapping, rejects ambiguity. Do not call capture connection-only.
allowed_field_classes: opaque kernel identifiers/pointers (local protected only; export hashed)
length-delimited SocketAddress binary (local protected only; export localhost ports only)
excluded: explicit all-provider or CaptureState rundown requests
release_gate: Only prepare/review. No trace/test/source correction until manual operator action and new coordinated single fixture start.
raw_container_limit: Only selected TCPIP event payloads are typed/no body or arbitrary string. ETL/control headers may contain local host/session/path/identity metadata; protected operator-local, never shared with Codex.
evidence_limit: Native send/ACK/retransmission/FIN-delivery/RST events, not packet capture. FIN wire-transmission is not directly represented by selected templates. Absence of events/state changes must remain UNKNOWN; cannot prove negative or wire FIN from TcpDeliveryFin/InjectFinComplete.

cleanup_contract.arming: Wait at most300s for fresh non-admin fixture-launch readiness; no session/provider before that. All source/host/profile/schema hashes verified before arming and before start.
cleanup_contract.watchdog: Before StartTrace, spawn separate hidden child of manual elevated operator (no RunAs/UAC), same reviewed helper -Watchdog mode. Child validates RunId/session GUID/profile hash and emits protected ready marker within5s. Parent aborts without StartTrace if child not ready/alive. Absolute monotonic deadline45s assigned before child launch.
cleanup_contract.ownership: One descriptive fixed session name PR81-Loopback-TCP-Metadata, fresh Wnode.Guid=RunId. Refuse any pre-existing session; do not auto-stop/reuse it. Watchdog queries exact name and requires exact fresh GUID before any stop; never global/prefix enumeration.
cleanup_contract.failure: Watchdog remains independent of parent/finally; at deadline query/stop only exact owned GUID even if parent dies. Parent uses finally+normal earlystop when fresh fixture completion marker arrives. No script kills unrelated processes. If query/stop fails, no sanitized release output; record only numericerror, display exact emergency owned-session stop command and require operator check.
cleanup_contract.termination_check: Parent and watchdog record returned numeric statuses; query after stop must report session absent. No claim guaranteed cleanup across OS shutdown or both controller/watchdog kill; emergency operator action if it occurs.

sanitized_output_contract.share_only: Validated JSON metadata, no ETL/raw content/ToXml dumps to Codex. Export only unique localhost4tuple+fixturePID+TCB matching; reject unknown eventID/version/template drift, ambiguous/reused mapping, any loss/overwrite, missing boundary coverage.
sanitized_output_contract.retain: RunId, schema/profile hashes, durations/statuses/loss counters, known localhost ports and fixturePID, hashed TCB aliases, allowlisted numeric sequence/length/window/state/error fields/timestamps. No raw pointer/address/SID/host/user/path/eventmessage/string fields.
sanitized_output_contract.bounds: Sanitized JSON max1MiB, eventcount<=4096; schema validation plus independent check against known synthetic event fixtures before manual READY.

raw_protection.directory: Current operator LOCALAPPDATA/PR81TcpTrace/<freshRunId>; local drive only, no reparse/UNC/cloud/share path, newly created, no reuse
raw_protection.acl: Inheritance disabled; operator current SID, LocalSystem SID and BuiltinAdministrators SID FullControl only, inherited children; verify resulting ACL before StartTrace. No account/group changes.
raw_protection.retention: Raw ETL remains operator-local/protected. Do not attach/read ETL in Codex. After accepted sanitized export and explicit operator retention decision, cleanup only exact validated freshRunId directory with ownership marker; no broad parent deletion.
raw_protection.sanitized_folder: Separate task control folder holds safe hashes/localhost ports/PID/status and sanitized JSON only; no raw ETL/XML/event messages copied.

no_overwrite_acceptance: Before export require all loss counters0 and conservative (BuffersWritten+1)*BufferSize*1024 <8MiB; otherwise circular overwrite possible, preserve raw locally and report incomplete/no delivery counts.
termination_operations: Watchdog at absolute45s requests disable for exact owned provider/session (Timeout1000ms), then Stop exact GUID. Parent also disable+stop in finally. Query absent required. Failed/blocked native stop or controller+watchdog termination is not guaranteed cleanup; no export, explicit operator action with exact owned session only.
